message: Line 1 has '*' as the first non-blank character in columns 8-72 (column 8) instead of the column 7 indicator; skipped as a comment.

01 WS-STATS-RECORD (line 18, written in Area B) lies inside EXEC SQL BEGIN DECLARE SECTION (line 17) / END DECLARE SECTION (line 30). The EXEC SQL delimiters are not data items; the record and its 11 fields are registered as an ordinary WORKING-STORAGE record.

COPY SQLCA (line 32), COPY DBPROC (line 33) and COPY ERRHAND (line 34) sit directly under the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION, outside any 01 record. Their 7 records (01-level: SQL-STATUS-CODES, DB2-ERROR-HANDLING and the 5 ERRHAND records) are linked by EXPANDS_COPY from section SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0057-SEC-0002 and count only in the copybooks' own records, not in this file's total_bytes.
